summary: PennantPark Private Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting a routine issuance of 110,906 common shares at $25.82/share (aggregate $2.9M) under its continuous private offering. The offer relied on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D for accredited investors. Item 8.01 merely disclosed net asset value. No change-of-control, strategic review, or special situation. This is ordinary capital-raising, not a special event.
